format.states: float32 [E,T+1,N,13] pos3, quat xyzw (sign-continuous), linvel3, angvel3 (world); Y-up metres
format.rest: bool [E,T+1,N] dynamic object in contact and |v|<0.01 and |w|<0.05
format.episode_index: int64 [E] index within the split (seed = hash(base_seed, split, index))
format.init_penetration: float32 [E] deepest object-object/support/floor overlap at t=0 (m, >=0)

ranges.mass_kg: log-uniform 0.05-3 (half of objects: density 150-2500 kg/m3 clipped to that range)
ranges.size_m: 0.02-0.35 per axis (desk items use demo_desk sizes x0.85-1.15, phone 0.009 thick)
ranges.non_live: each of the five unobservable parameters is randomized with p=0.7 (at least one)
ranges.table: w 0.9-1.5, d 0.65-1.0, h 0.6-0.9 (generate_data); desk layouts mostly 1.2x0.8x0.75
ranges.tilt_deg: tilt_slide 5-35 (12%: 35-60) on x or z (15% both); legacy +-25; sprinkled +-15 on hard kinds
ranges.push: gentle 0.02-0.5 Ns (speed capped 0.8 m/s); hard pushes 0.3-4.5 m/s * mass (<=20 Ns); 2D and 3D
ranges.drop: gap 0.02-0.30 m, yaw-only / small tilt / fully random orientation, optional initial lin/ang velocity
ranges.dropped: episodes with non-finite states, |pos|>50, or an object leaving the 20 m floor (y<-0.5 or |x|,|z|>10)

meta.rest_definition: in contact and |v|<0.01 m/s and |w|<0.05 rad/s
meta.contact_definition: Bullet contact point with distance <= 0.001 m in the last substep (frame 0: closest-point query); a static desk duplicating the support counts as support
meta.chaotic_definition: any dynamic object fell or tipped (summarize semantics), or moved > 0.30 m from its start at any frame, or a contact between two dynamic objects began after t=0 with relative COM speed > 0.5 m/s
meta.live_physics_definition: restitution, rolling and spinning friction 0 for every object; support friction 0.5; support restitution 0

metric_definitions.pos_err_m: mean |p_pred - p_true| over dynamic real objects at the horizon (pooled over objects of the subset)
metric_definitions.fell: object-level confusion vs dataset fell; predicted with the agatha.physics.summarize rule on all 20 Hz frames
metric_definitions.penetration: max(support, floor, objects) depth from contact_gnn.penetration_depths per dynamic object-frame (t>=1; floor depth ignored where the object centre is beyond the finite 20 m floor): mean, mean with per-frame depth capped at 50 mm (robust to fall-through outliers), fraction > 5 mm, max
metric_definitions.rest_drift: over object-frames where dataset rest is True (t>=1): fd_speed = |p_t - p_{t-1}|/0.05 of the PREDICTION, state_speed = predicted |v|
metric_definitions.diverged_episodes: rollouts with a non-finite or |x|>1000 state; frozen at last good state and still scored
metric_definitions.out_of_bounds_episodes: rollouts where a dynamic object reaches y < -0.5 m, |x| or |z| > 10 m or |p| > 50 m at any frame (the generator rejects such ground truth); still scored
metric_definitions.pos_err_active_m: pos_err_m restricted to dynamic objects whose ground-truth displacement exceeds 0.02 m at some frame or that fell / tipped
metric_definitions.latency_ms_per_step: batch 1, CPU (4 threads), first episode, mean over 60 autoregressive steps (shared machine: indicative)

physics_reference.description: PyBullet ground truth scored with the same metrics (floor for penetration / rest drift)

old_mlp_projected.description: old mlp_multistep + the non-learned contact projection (attribution only)

new_raw.description: ContactGNN alone: learned model only, no projection

new_projected.description: ContactGNN + non-learned contact projection after every step (configuration that would ship)

ship_decision.rule: ship iff, vs old_mlp: chaotic pos err @2s improves AND mean penetration improves AND gentle pos err @2s <= old * 1.02; AND (when old_mlp_projected was evaluated) vs old_mlp_projected: chaotic pos err @2s improves AND gentle pos err @2s <= old_projected * 1.02 AND capped mean penetration <= old_projected + 1 mm. Gates use point estimates; 'significant' reports whether the paired-bootstrap 95% CI agrees

new_projected.description: ContactGNN + non-learned contact projection after every step (configuration that would ship)

new_raw.description: ContactGNN alone: learned model only, no projection

ship_decision.statement: new_projected = learned ContactGNN + NON-LEARNED contact projection (what would ship); new_raw = the learned model ALONE. The penetration gate against raw old_mlp can be passed by the projection alone, so the gain is only attributed to the learned model when beats_old_projected is true (same projection on the old model).

ship_decision_all_physics.rule: ship iff, vs old_mlp: chaotic pos err @2s improves AND mean penetration improves AND gentle pos err @2s <= old * 1.02; AND (when old_mlp_projected was evaluated) vs old_mlp_projected: chaotic pos err @2s improves AND gentle pos err @2s <= old_projected * 1.02 AND capped mean penetration <= old_projected + 1 mm. Gates use point estimates; 'significant' reports whether the paired-bootstrap 95% CI agrees

new_projected.description: ContactGNN + non-learned contact projection after every step (configuration that would ship)

new_raw.description: ContactGNN alone: learned model only, no projection

ship_decision_all_physics.statement: new_projected = learned ContactGNN + NON-LEARNED contact projection (what would ship); new_raw = the learned model ALONE. The penetration gate against raw old_mlp can be passed by the projection alone, so the gain is only attributed to the learned model when beats_old_projected is true (same projection on the old model).

notes: Autoregressive rollouts from the true t=0 state over the full episode; never teacher-forced.
old = previously shipped mlp_multistep; new_raw = learned ContactGNN alone; new_projected = ContactGNN + a NON-LEARNED contact projection applied after every step (the shipped configuration).

Headline subset is live_physics: episodes whose hidden physics parameters equal the live API defaults; gentle/chaotic is the dataset outcome flag (fell, tipped, >0.30 m displacement or >0.5 m/s object collision).

The live subset is not a random half of every scenario: legacy_layout (the old model's own training distribution) is always live and so is over-represented in it (see live_subset_kinds), which favours the old model; live and all-physics numbers are not comparable kind by kind.

pos_err_active = position error over the objects that actually move in the ground truth (> 2 cm, fell or tipped); the plain chaotic mean also averages resting bystanders. The ship gates are point estimates; "significant" marks a paired-bootstrap 95% CI that excludes zero.
out_of_bounds_episodes = rollouts where a dynamic object left the world (y < -0.5 m, |x| or |z| > 10 m); diverged_episodes only counts non-finite / >1e3 states.

Penetration = mean over dynamic object-frames of the deepest overlap with support, floor or another box (corner-in-box test, so edge-edge overlaps are under-counted); physics_reference is the floor of this metric.
Rest drift = mean finite-difference speed on object-frames where ground truth is at rest in contact.
Synthetic PyBullet boxes only; errors grow with horizon and chaotic outcomes remain sensitive to initial conditions.
